summary: This is a routine 8-K filing by Fortress Net Lease REIT disclosing its monthly net asset value (NAV) per share as of March 31, 2026, calculated under board-approved valuation guidelines. The filing reports NAV per share by class (ranging from $10.40 to $10.91) and provides a breakdown of total NAV ($1.73 billion) and components such as real estate investments and debt. No transaction, activist activity, strategic review, or corporate action is announced. This is a standard periodic disclosure for an unlisted REIT, not a special situation.
